hooks.command:
jq -r '.transcript_path' | { read -r tp; prompt=$(jq -rs '[.[] | select(.type=="user" and (.message.content|type)=="string")] | last | .message.content' "$tp" 2>/dev/null); printf 'Prompt: %s
Timestamp: %s
Date: %s

' "$prompt" "$(date +%H:%M:%S)" "$(date +%Y-%m-%d)" >> "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/timestamp.txt"; } 2>/dev/null || true
